title: Unit Event — Unreliable Notes

meta.Outline: Kanade delves into the "warmth" Mafuyu feels from her music, hoping to identify its nature. When she learns it relates to a memory of Mafuyu's mother, she starts working on a new song, but finds something isn't right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Am I taking this song in the right direction...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope that it has some effect on Mafuyu's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Even when it was still just a demo, I had a good feeling about this song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Me too!
It really hits home for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I really appreciate you all saying that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still haven't been able to save Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu's dad has come to terms with her feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which I think has helped put her mind at ease a little. However...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She still looks to be in pain from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to compose a song that can save her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I've written a number of songs already, and every time, I feel like I'm missing something.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You often say that my songs feel “warm”...
What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you trying to ask?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry, that came out of nowhere.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... You know how you often talk about how my songs feel “warm”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: From what I understand, that warmth you feel means quite a lot to you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If I can learn more about where that comes from, then I think I can get closer to actually composing a song which can save you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see what you mean.
It's important to have a clear picture of what you want to create.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you know where that warmth comes from, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The warmth I feel from Kanade's songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I was little, I caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And my mom nursed me back to health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She's always busy with neighborhood association business...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But she stayed by my side the entire day that time.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She cut apple slices in the shape of rabbits for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I remember those being so delicious...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She even held my hand as she sang me lullabies.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The sensation I feel whenever I listen to one of your songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's similar to what I felt back then.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Kind of surprising to hear, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember what Mafuyu told us before? Listening to Kanade's songs feels like having apple slices, she said.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Putting two and two together, those were probably the same ones her mom made for her when she caught that cold, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
In that case...
I'll try composing a song based on that memory next.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu doesn't actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I must've missed so many warning signs.
I feel absolutely terrible.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't know what Mafuyu is going to work towards moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As painful as this is going to be for you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I plan on giving her all the support I can so that she's able to choose her path in life freely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (She never wanted to become a doctor...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (So, everything I've done... It was all a mistake?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: (I made the right choices, for her happiness.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm glad that Dad was doing okay.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(We actually got to talk a little today...
So, once I get home, I'll keep working on that song.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
In that case...
I'll try composing a song based on that memory next.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was bored, so I decided to see how you were doing. Remember how you talked about composing that song for Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm going to start on that song once I get home.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You seemed a little worried just now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The song isn't really coming together well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just can't get a clear vision of it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um... I have a better understanding of what the warmth Mafuyu has been feeling involves.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I just can't tie that together with her mother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because she feels like the complete opposite of that to me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. When I actually met her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... I can't really put it into words, but she felt like an icy shiver down my spine.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, during our conversation, I got the distinct feeling that she wasn't really thinking of what was best for Mafuyu at all.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So... I just can't picture that person as the source of the “warmth” Mafuyu feels.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's likely why I'm struggling right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. I don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But if Mafuyu feels that “warmth” from her mother in her memories...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then it must exist inside her somewhere, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She's right. I don't actually know that much about Mafuyu's mom. But...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Hello.
What a coincidence to see you here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, yes, it really is.
Are you doing some shopping, Mr. Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm buying things for dinner.
We're having hot pot tonight.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hot pot...
That sounds like a nice way to stay warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe Mafuyu and I can also have that tonight...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ah, forgive me. I want to believe that I have a good idea of how she's doing, since I've been seeing and talking to her each week...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But I imagine she still doesn't feel comfortable telling me certain things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I just hope she isn't pushing herself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ah, of course, you don't have to tell me if you don't feel comfortable. But any information would be greatly appreciated...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems much more at ease compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Before, she was always withdrawn, and constantly worried about her family...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But she's seemed much more stable lately.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I believe you've played a big role in that, Mr. Asahina, since you've made a genuine effort to understand what's been going on with her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really have to compose that song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I'm trying to compose a song for Mafuyu right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's actually smiled several times after listening to my songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know a single song won't be enough to turn this current situation around...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But if I can write a song that will lessen Mafuyu's burdens, even a little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
You really have done so much for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I wish I could repay your generosity somehow...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Could you tell me more about Mafuyu's mother?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You want to know about my wife?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry for asking that all of a sudden... Um...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'll need some time to explain everything, so why don't we find a place where we can sit down?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I see. I didn't know Mafuyu told you that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, how her mother cut apple slices for her after she caught a cold when she was little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It seemed to be a very warm memory for her... One that's very important to her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm not actually familiar with that specific story...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But I can certainly see my wife doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I can understand why that might come as a shock, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
The woman I know is a devoted person...
And a very loving mother.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That's difficult to put into words...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's as though she's poured everything she had into Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: My wife had Mafuyu learn and do anything and everything she believed would help our daughter achieve a bright future.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Oh, Mafuyu, you're already up?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yup! I woke up to help make your lunch today, Daddy! Mommy's showing me how!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I see... Thank you, Mafuyu.
But isn't she a little too young to be cooking?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Don't worry, I'll be the only one using the stove. My hope is that learning how to cook now will show her the value of the food she eats, and also teach her to plan ahead.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Hm? What are you reading there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Just a review, since we're taking Mafuyu to the history museum tomorrow. I want to make sure I can answer any questions that she asks.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I see. You really are a dedicated mother. I'll be counting on you when we go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Whenever Mafuyu seemed especially interested in something, my wife bought her learning materials... Even ones that were a bit advanced for a child.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: There were times when I thought my wife was going a little too far, but Mafuyu did seem to grow and learn quite a bit as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can see her mom doing all those things.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
There is one event which left a significant impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It happened when Mafuyu was still just a baby.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
She got a fever for the very first time.
A very high one at that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Despite being a very calm person, my wife came close to panicking....

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: To make matters worse, it was snowing very heavily that day. As a result, we couldn't drive Mafuyu to the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, my wife decided to carry her over on foot.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She was completely covered in white snow, using herself to shield Mafuyu from getting wet or cold.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She looked so different from the calm and composed woman I knew... I remember being shocked by the sight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But she relaxed when we heard that all Mafuyu had was a cold. After that, my wife returned to being her usual self...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ever since Mafuyu was born... Ever since I held her in my arms for the first time, I've loved her unconditionally. She still means the world to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And I'm sure that my wife feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Hearing that story, I can understand why he feels that way...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Was that not quite what you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What you've said just differs slightly from the impression I have of Mafuyu's mother...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As my wife grew more convinced that she was making all the correct decisions for Mafuyu, the further that belief led her astray...and the same applies to me, as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, we forgot to ask what our daughter was actually feeling. Or rather, we felt that we already knew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That may've been why she seemed so cold to you, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But I will say... I don't think she's changed from the woman who carried Mafuyu to this hospital that day.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But how is Mafuyu's mother doing right now?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
She hasn't left the house...
She sits there all alone, without even turning the lights on.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I believe she's been thinking on what happened between her and Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: My wife and I... We honestly don't know how to proceed moving forward, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
That probably isn't very helpful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I appreciate you telling me all this...
So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu will likely be in your care for a little while longer, so please keep looking after her for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Sorry I'm late, dear.
Let's have some hot pot tonight. I bought everything we need, so I'll get it ready in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: My goal is to make what you usually do, but that may be easier said than done. Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Also...
I ran into Ms. Yoisaki today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As usual, she's been taking very good care of Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She even said that she's composing a song for her right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I was also told a story about Mafuyu catching a cold when she was little. And how you cut apple slices for her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Yes, what you did for her apparently made her very happy. Her heart was filled with quite a bit of warmth.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She's been holding on to that memory ever since. It seems to mean a great deal to her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That's what Ms. Yoisaki told me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu's blessed to have such a good friend who cares so much about her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: A friend who's willing to stop and help her find the right path when she's feeling lost.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I want to be able to empathize with Mafuyu more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I want to see her really smile in front of us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If it's true that Mafuyu doesn't actually want to become a doctor...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, perhaps what I did... It was all a huge mistake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Does that mean Ms. Yoisaki is in the right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But Mafuyu's changed so much since meeting her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: She began skipping her cram school lessons, her grades slipped, and she even lied to us... She never used to behave like that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I'm not saying that you were wrong.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If that's how it sounded... Then I truly am sorry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, Mafuyu has changed.
I was honestly startled when I first noticed...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: However, after speaking with Mafuyu, I believe that she is still fundamentally the same person.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She's still the kind girl who looks out for the well-being of others, even when she herself is suffering.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: She's still the Mafuyu we both know and love.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Remember when she was just born?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It was a cold, cold day in January.
You had been in labor longer than expected, and I was so worried, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: When Mafuyu was born, she was so small...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And when I touched her, she grabbed my finger with her little hand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I realized that I had to do everything I could to keep the newborn in your arms safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: “She's so small, lovable and full of warmth.”

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Which is why you suggested that we name her Mafuyu... “midwinter”. So that we'd never forget the sensation we felt that day... The warmth of that tiny little body.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: After that, Mafuyu began to grow into the kind and thoughtful young lady that she is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
And we wanted her to be happy...
We both talked about that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Seeing her smile filled me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I felt that I had to make her happy, no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I want to talk to Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's time to compose that song.
And save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, this still doesn't sound right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mr. Asahina said that Mafuyu's mom is very loving...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The warmth Mafuyu associates with those apple slices is likely an expression of her mother's love.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I have to find a sound which represents that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should start again from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think it's a good song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I picture Mafuyu's mother, the sound ends up turning cold, no matter what I do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I tried working in my own mother's warmth...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But it just isn't what Mafuyu felt.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I can't lean on my own experiences.
I have to focus on Mafuyu and what she felt.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's the same as everything else I've come up with so far...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How do I capture that maternal love that Mafuyu felt?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Changing the melody or a few chords hasn't solved anything.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (There's something missing...on a more fundamental level?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I thought I had the right idea at the demo stage, but I feel like I'm stepping backwards each time I add a note or chord.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(How do I capture that warmth in sound?
Am I using too many slashed chords? If I change the structure...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (No, this song may just be completely broken.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel like nothing I come up with is going to make it better.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My next idea has to work.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You need to eat something, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have something once I've reached a good stopping point.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's been getting warmer lately, but please continue to be mindful of your health.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Let's see... Ms. Yoisaki is composing her song in the other room, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I should at least say hello before I leave.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'll be excusing myself now, Ms. Yoisaki.
Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I apologize for not sitting with you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hope you get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
But... Are you feeling okay?
You look rather pallid...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm okay...
I didn't get enough sleep last night, that's all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Then, you should rest for a bit.
Mafuyu, can you help Ms. Yoisaki to her bed?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You look exhausted, so you should spend the remainder of the day resting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My mind's still wide awake. I can't fall asleep...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Before I forget... I have to remember what I was doing for that song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Start in a minor key...
Then change to a major key, and...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No matter how hard I try, I can't find the answer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What's the right sound? Does it need more mid-bass? Which keys haven't I tried yet...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, you mean that asset I asked you to make?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, it just took longer than expected.
I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, this looks great! I'll try plopping this in now!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright... In that case, I'm gonna take a quick break.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Have fun♪
I've got lots more assets for you to make, so I'll tell you about them after you get back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
<I guess we should take this opportunity to polish everything up really nicely, since K still seems to be busy.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Actually, speaking of her...
She's been staying offline to compose that song for you, Yuki, but I'm starting to get worried...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, she hasn't been on at all lately...
Knowing her, I'm worried she's not getting enough rest again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fortunately, Yuki's with her, so I'm sure she's at least getting something to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She's been eating during the sporadic breaks she's been taking. But only very little...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Only a little? Are you sure she's okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No, she's gonna collapse again!
You gotta tell her to eat more, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't think she's heard a word I've said.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She just keeps mumbling that her song is all wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I got worried and decided to see how Kanade was doing.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She spent all of today working again, nonstop.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But, why?
She's had a few slumps here and there, but nothing this bad, not recently...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What do you mean by that, Rin?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, Yuki, what was that sound just now?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do I capture the warmth Mafuyu felt?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't get it right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I have to find it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The sound that will save Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That voice. Where have I heard it before...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I-Is everything okay? Are you looking for your mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I looked all over for you, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Didn't I tell you to never leave my side?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
As long as we're together, you'll be happy.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: After all, I am your mother.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: H-Huh...? I can't move... My body...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: <You're pushing yourself way too hard, Kanade!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I have Ena and Mizuki here on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Are you alright, Kanade?
You should rest and give your body a chance to recover.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Also, Mafuyu was worried sick about you...
She told us you've hardly had anything to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you all worry about me like this...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's okay. You don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I mean, you're composing this song just for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd rather you didn't push yourself so hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Are you feeling nauseous at all, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...
But my head is spinning a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, you should have something to eat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree.
Something simple like rice porridge is probably your best option right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I think I can handle that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll go make some now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, you need to focus on resting right now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we wait, can we chat for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thank goodness! Man, you had us worried there for a second. We were all working and then we heard this big thud!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I thought my heart was gonna stop when I heard that you'd collapsed, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Rin and Mafuyu told us everything earlier.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The song you're composing really has you stuck, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We can't really give you any advice when it comes to composing music...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But if there's something else bothering you, we'd like it if you could tell us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Telling us might help clear your head and make way for some good ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can you tell us exactly why you feel that way?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I realized something after hearing that story and talking to Mafuyu's dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The warmth Mafuyu felt when having those apple slices was an expression of her mom's love...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I've been trying to work that into this song...
But it hasn't been going very well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Still, that's really surprising.
I feel like you'd have no trouble capturing that.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Do you know what's causing this, Kanade?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a dream just now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was about Mafuyu being taken somewhere by her mom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm having trouble composing this song because I still don't entirely trust her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In Mafuyu's memories of her, as well as the story Mr. Asahina told me... She's a devoted, and deeply loving person.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
When I'm composing...
I keep being reminded of the coldness I felt when I actually met her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's what's getting in the way of me fully realizing that warmth they talked about.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: As a result, I've spent all this time running around in circles...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just can't align the person they remember with the person I spoke to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I kinda get what you mean, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I haven't talked to her in person like you, Kanade, but I have over the phone... And even from that, I could hardly believe a word of what Mafuyu was telling us earlier.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And Kanade, you've been doing so much to protect Mafuyu all this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Maybe that's helped widen this gap you're feeling.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's completely normal for you to feel that way, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, how you see someone can be totally different from the way others view them.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And of course, understanding how someone else sees something isn't as simple as just hearing a few stories from them.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you might be right...
And we're talking about a person's family here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Some people can only act a certain way when they're with their families, you know? Others don't get to see that behavior...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We have no way of knowing what happens behind closed doors. The good and the bad.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't think there's any way to make the way Mafuyu sees her mom align perfectly with how I picture her.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But unless I find some way to do it, I won't ever be able to finish this song...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At this point, I feel that all you can do is go and see for yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If I were you, I wouldn't be happy with whatever it is that I made unless I solved the puzzle you're dealing with first.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, I think you should go, see for yourself... And then put that sensation, whatever you find, into your song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That might help bring your vision closer to Mafuyu's. Or, it could make things even harder for you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But as long as you don't know for sure, I don't think you'll be able to move from where you are now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Honestly, I didn't want to learn any more than I had to about Mafuyu's mom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because I was so convinced that we'd never see eye to eye. I felt that I didn't have to make an effort to understand her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't compose based on information that I don't have. It's impossible for me to turn a feeling I don't hold within myself into sound.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's how things have always been for me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Which is why...
I feel that I should get to know Mafuyu's mom better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're looking a lot better already, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm sorry for making you worry so much, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, I'll contact Mafuyu's mom now and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! Now?! Are you crazy?!
You need to keep resting!!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
But sleeping feels like such a waste.
I want to keep working on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Are you still there, Mafuyu?! Get in here and put Kanade to bed already!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I heard Ena shouting just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Kanade said she's gonna keep working on that song! She needs to take it easy for the rest of the day!!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I said I don't want you to push yourself so hard, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I promise to spend today resting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: About not being able to properly compose this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Once I do...once I have a grasp on that warmth, I know I'll be able to do it right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, please bear with me for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I also want to know more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to see if what I felt was real.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's go find out together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (Ms. Yoisaki has been so good to Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (On top of letting Mafuyu stay at her house, Ms. Yoisaki's been going so far to make her smile...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu's been willing to talk a little more recently...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: (But I hope this leads to the both of them talking soon.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: What do you have there? Are you getting some knitting done?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was just going through an album of when Mafuyu was little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It reminded me of how easily she used to catch chill...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: This is about all I can do for her right now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
The scarf you made looks very warm.
I'm sure she's going to love it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, this is just an idea...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your dad should be arriving soon, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
My mind is already made up.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to see if I can talk to my mom.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means I also have to push forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You seem good again today. Any changes since we last met?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: That reminds me. I have something for you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It can still get very cold all of a sudden, so she hopes this will help you keep warm.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I also have a proposal I'd like to make...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: How would you feel about talking to your mother?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I feel like you've improved a considerable amount compared to before, thanks in no small part to Ms. Yoisaki's care.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And... Your mother is also in a condition to talk now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, would you be willing to try talking to her again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Of course, you don't have to if you're not comfortable. And you don't have to give me your answer today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. My, aren't we full of demands today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, dear. Now, lie down for me, and take my hand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll understand, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Because you're such a good, kind girl who I know will do the right thing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also need to start moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Kanade's making such a sincere effort to know.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was also thinking I want to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want you there with me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I talk to her, I want you to also be there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That is, if it isn't going to be a problem...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Not at all. Please come join us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You being there will make Mafuyu feel better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You've spent all this time looking after her, so I'd greatly appreciate it if you were also present.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Understood...
In that case, thank you for agreeing to this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's tell her about how you really feel.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is going to be a crucial conversation for Mafuyu. So, I want to be there to support her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Also, this isn't quite how I was expecting to learn more about Mafuyu's mom, but this is going to be my chance.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have to do whatever I can.)
